correctness.rationale: At weight n+2 the zeros are an independent set, with exactly one per rung outside the two completely colored rungs. For a run, the two end-neighbor colors and the run's positive colors in between form a sequence whose sliding triples must have all three colors, so the first two distinct labels force the rest by period three. Its endpoint matrix is 2I if the run length is 2 mod 3, J−I otherwise. For adjacent holes there are 108 colorings per unordered pair, including n=3. With nonadjacent holes the zero-row difference between the two run ends changes parity by n−4. Thus for odd n one hole shares its constrained vertex and one does not, giving 144 colorings per pair; summing gives 108n+144(C(n,2)−n)=36n(2n−3). For 6|n, two orientations have both endpoints shared, two neither. For the shared case the count before free colors is tr(R_p R_q), correctly using symmetry to reverse one run. The directed-distance counts are 288,180,180 for the three residues of d mod 3, each occurring n/3−1 times, and the directed sum must be halved even for opposite holes. Adding adjacent holes gives 108n(n−2). This proves the replacement without assuming the minimum theorem. The same kernel gives the frozen rest of the table: no holes require both cyclic periods two and three; one hole shares the endpoint iff n is even; for the remaining even two-hole cases the trace values reduce to 6 and 0, with 180 at one distance residue and 72 at the other two. No falsity is alleged for those removed branches.
correctness.replay: /workspace/review-evidence/prism2.py and prism2.txt: exact independent cyclic transfer trace for every n=3,…,36. Pair states (a,b) of columns transition to (b,c) if all zero conditions in b hold according to the prism adjacency; the degree of the transition records whether b is fully colored. No rung may have two zeros. A rooted closed path of length n is one labeled assignment, not a quotient by a cyclic shift. The coefficients through degree 2 agree with the full frozen table; the proof, not this finite check, establishes the repaired all-n claim. The frozen verifier and saved output were inspected, not rerun.

value.rationale: The two nonminimum branches finish a natural low-weight coefficient across all circumferences, after accounting for the complementary classes where the optimum census already supplies it. These are exhaustive symbolic counts for infinite classes, not an arbitrary set of extra examples, and the contrast between odd (one shared hole) and even (two or none) explains the differing multiplicities. A researcher using low-weight terms of the labeling polynomial cannot substitute the optimum count for these branches.
